entries.175f58e89c2699ba: A region where Zhongshan Fulasite Industrial Co., Ltd. in Zhongshan, Guangdong Province, and Wuhan Fulasite Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. in Wuhan, Hubei Province, manufacture and sell safety components and resin parts. entries.19ab59dcdb5bfb07: Revenue by region for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was largest in North America at ¥57,019 million; Japan was ¥43,291 million, China ¥10,953 million and Southeast Asia ¥3,596 million, with production and sales centered overseas. By product, safety components were ¥58,220 million and resin components ¥56,617 million, roughly on par. Its major customer is Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. (¥26,190 million, 22.8% of consolidated revenue), and sales to its subsidiary Nissan North America, Inc. were also ¥17,142 million (14.9%), so sales to the Nissan Group account for a large share.

entries.e7e072bf9ae912c8: As a specialist manufacturer of safety components and resin components, the company group is advancing performance development using simulation analysis technology, as well as weight reduction and cost reduction, built on materials and molding technologies. In addition to resin molding technology, it has magnesium casting and aluminum casting technologies, painting technology, decoration technology and assembly technology; for safety components, it proposes new value as an HMI device that conveys information by giving steering wheels alarm and sensing functions.
